sentences.en: It was very difficult for her to control her emotions.
sentences.zh: 她很难控制自己的情绪。

sentences.en: It was very hard for her to suppress her emotions.
sentences.zh: 她很难压抑住自己的情绪。

sentences.en: Having a competitive mentality can give rise to negative emotions.
sentences.zh: 竞争心态可能会引发负面情绪。

senses.zh: 情绪的， 情感的； emotionally

mnemonic: 词根记忆：e（出）+mot（动）+ion→动出感情→感情
